reason: The money-back guarantee is good, but I can't take a new company with no results to my board and ask them to let outsiders plug into our CCTV and POS. If it goes wrong I am the one who recommended it, so this month I would watch, not sign.
objection: No customer results, and they want access to our camera footage and sales data. The board will ask who else uses them and what happens to our data, and I have no answer.
would_change_my_mind: One named chain of our size that ran the test and will take my call, plus a contract that makes clear our data stays ours and gets deleted if we stop.
